description: Class representing a theme font scheme.

Copy.description: Creates a copy of the current theme font scheme.

GetClassType.description: Returns the type of the ApiThemeFontScheme class.

GetMajorFont.description: Returns the major theme font of the current theme font scheme.

params.description: The script the font is applied to.
params.name: script

returns.description: The font name, an empty string if the scheme has no font for this script, or null if the script is not supported.

GetMinorFont.description: Returns the minor theme font of the current theme font scheme.

params.description: The script the font is applied to.
params.name: script

returns.description: The font name, an empty string if the scheme has no font for this script, or null if the script is not supported.

GetSchemeName.description: Returns the name of the current theme font scheme.

SetFonts.description: Sets the fonts to the current theme font scheme.

params.description: The major theme font applied to the latin text.
params.name: mjLatin

params.description: The major theme font applied to the east asian text.
params.name: mjEa

params.description: The major theme font applied to the complex script text.
params.name: mjCs

params.description: The minor theme font applied to the latin text.
params.name: mnLatin

params.description: The minor theme font applied to the east asian text.
params.name: mnEa

params.description: The minor theme font applied to the complex script text.
params.name: mnCs

SetFonts.signature: SetFonts(mjLatin: string, mjEa: string, mjCs: string, mnLatin: string, mnEa: string, mnCs: string): void

SetSchemeName.description: Sets a name to the current theme font scheme.

returns.description: returns false if font scheme doesn't exist.

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiThemeFontScheme object into the JSON object.
